## Checklist

- [ ] `cargo test` and `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` pass
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`); see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] Non-trivial change: proposed in `openspec/changes/` first
- [ ] Docs updated (`docs/architecture.md` and `docs/roadmap.md` if status moved)
- [ ] No keys, internal hostnames or private config in the diff
